display_empty_normal.genuine_output: loginctl show-session c1 --all: Display= (empty, Type=tty); c2 --all: Display= (empty, Type=unspecified/manager)
display_empty_normal.source: systemd v262 src/login/pam_systemd.c: type defaults to x11 only when display nonempty (c->type = !isempty(c->display) ? x11 : ...); Display is the X11 display string, Wayland sessions normally leave it empty

genuine_loginctl_transcript: $ loginctl show-session c1 -p Id -p User -p Name -p Seat -p Type -p Class -p State -p Display -p Remote -p Service -p TTY  ->  Id=c1, User=1001, Name=builder, Seat=(empty), TTY=pts/1, Display=(empty), Remote=no, Service=login, Type=tty, Class=user, State=active
note: Captured live on builder 2026-10-18; pinned live systemd is 262-1 per testing/boot-failure/dt25-software-env-rationale.json

primary_sources.logind_session_dbus_v262: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/systemd/systemd/v262/src/login/logind-session-dbus.c :: property_get_user appends (uint32_t)uid + user path as (uo); property_get_name appends user_name as s; session_vtable: SD_BUS_PROPERTY(User,(uo),...) + SD_BUS_PROPERTY(Name,s,...); no UID entry (grep UID in vtable: none)

schema_conclusion: Real session identity = numeric User + string Name; UID property does not exist; repeated -p required; Display empty is normal for Wayland. Supervisor + tests now match this; old comma-p/User==live/UID/nonempty-Display assumptions removed.
